llm.summary: The skill is a CloudKit code-review guide with no executable payload, but it gives an unbundled sibling protocol authority to block reported findings.

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to inspect project files such as Swift source, entitlements, and Info.plist, which is proportionate for CloudKit code review. The concern is the unbundled external protocol, not broad local access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script, executable file, package dependency, network fetch, or tool wrapper was present; metadata.json is empty and the artifact consists of markdown files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: artifact/SKILL.md requires pre-report steps from ../review-verification-protocol/SKILL.md and says there is no finding if that external protocol is not satisfied. That external file is not present in the inspected artifact, so unreviewed instructions can affect or suppress review output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No agent persistence, startup task, cron job, memory write, credential access, or privilege escalation was found. Info.plist and UserDefaults references are CloudKit app-review examples, not skill persistence mechanisms.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: markdown guidance for reviewing CloudKit container setup, records, subscriptions, and sharing. The shipped files are documentation and Swift/XML examples, not runnable payloads.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing. The CloudKit guidance itself is normal documentation, but the skill depends on a sibling review-verification-protocol file that was not included for review. Install only if that external protocol is trusted, bundled, or pinned; otherwise review findings could be changed or suppressed without visibility.
llm.findings:
[RA2] expected: SkillSpector's session-persistence concern appears to be a false positive on CloudKit review text mentioning Info.plist and app UserDefaults; the artifact does not install persistent agent behavior.
[T01] unexpected: The static scan's instruction-scope concern is supported by artifact/SKILL.md: the skill makes an out-of-package review-verification protocol mandatory and lets it veto findings.
